_comment: Mod sources the DDS2 Mod Manager maintainers have looked at.
Fetched by the manager on startup and cached locally, so adding an entry here reaches
everyone without shipping a new build of the app.
An entry vouches for a GitHub ACCOUNT, and only for that. It means a download fetched from
that account is coming from somewhere the maintainers have looked at.
It does NOT vouch for any particular mod. A mod declares its own update address and nothing
is signed, so a mod naming an account is not evidence it came from that account - the claim
gains an attacker nothing (updates would be fetched from the real account's repository, which
they don't control) but it would still look reassuring. Nor does it mean safe forever: an
account can be compromised later. The manager still asks before installing anything.
owner       required. GitHub account. Matched case-insensitively.
repo        optional. Verifies only that repository. Leave it out to verify everything
the owner publishes - only do that for people you'd vouch for unreservedly.
verifiedBy  optional. Who added the entry, so a stale one can be chased up.

entries.note: Creator and maintainer of DDS2 Mod Manager.
